messages:
maria.partnerships: Quick heads-up — AWS Marketplace is asking for a hardware-vendor attestation in addition to SOC2 Type II and the pen-test report. Need to map owners, upload path, and public blurb. Can Kai (AcmeHW) join this thread?
marketplace-bot: Reminder: marketplace listing gate includes: SOC2 report (pdf), pen-test report + remediation note, hw/vendor attestation letter, questionnaire answers, and dataflow diagram. See https://internal.redwood/marketplace/checklist :clipboard:
kai.hw-liaison: Hi all — I can coordinate AcmeHW signature. Quick Q: what should the attestation contain? electronic signature ok?
ashley.security: E-sign is fine. Attestation needs signer name, title, company, statement of attestation, and date. Also we need pen-test scope and a remediation statement from vendor or our side. SOC2: auditor pdf + letter.
devon.eng-runtime: We should also include a redacted deploy config (no IPs/keys) describing VPC/on-prem options for the HW combo. I can produce a sanitized `deploy.yaml` snippet.
oliver.ops: Ops prefers uploads via presigned S3 link (7d expiry). I'll create folder `marketplace/listings/redwood-llm/attestations/<thread_ts>/` and post link here.
maria.partnerships: Action items: Kai to confirm signer + provide draft attestation, Ashley to own pen-test scope + questionnaire edits, Devon to produce redacted deploy.yaml, Oliver to provide presign link. Deadlines: Kai EOD Tue, Ashley COB Wed, Devon EOD Mon. Agree?
ashley.security: Confirmed on pen-test scope. I'll coordinate with our vendor (RedPen) — scope: infra surface, public APIs, dedicated GPU nodes, auth flows. ETA Wed COB. I'll also attach the questionnaire template in ticket.
kai.hw-liaison: Confirming AcmeHW signer: Lina Gomez, VP Legal. E-sign ok. I'll upload draft attestation by Tue morning. Will need the template.
marketplace-bot: Template: https://internal.redwood/templates/hw-attestation-template.docx
devon.eng-runtime: Sample redaction I'll drop into the ticket now:
```yaml
# redacted deploy.yaml sample
vpc: redacted
subnets:
  - redacted
gpu_config:
  instance_type: g4dn.xlarge
  node_count: 4
secrets: redacted
```
oliver.ops: Presigned upload link (7d): https://s3.redwood/internal-presign/abcd1234 — please upload under `redwood-llm/attestations/1712349999/`. Ping me after upload for verification.
maria.partnerships: I added this to marketplace ticket MP-4421 and set a reminder for Thurs AM to verify checklist completeness. Also need a 1-paragraph public blurb about the partnership for the listing (legal-approved). Who can draft?
kai.hw-liaison: I can draft the blurb, but legal will need to approve. Will aim to share a draft with Maria by Wed.
ashley.security: Also we need the public listing to include our customer-key policy: short sentence like "Customers retain full control of their encryption keys; Redwood does not persist customer-managed keys." I'll post exact wording in MP-4421.
devon.eng-runtime: :thumbsup: I'll PR the redacted `deploy.yaml` to the ticket and link the PR here when done.
maria.partnerships: Great — summary for the thread: Kai (attestation) EOD Tue, Ashley (pen-test + wording) COB Wed, Devon (redacted config) EOD Mon, Oliver (upload link) posted. I'll follow up in MP-4421 and circle back once attestation is signed. Thanks everyone :pray:
